Frequently asked questions

What is the current Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update?

26C is the current update on this site and 26D is next. Oracle updates environments in cohorts: test environments on the first Friday of the update month and production two weeks later, on the third Friday. Your cohort is shown in the Oracle Cloud Console.

What switches on automatically in 26C?

120 of the 148 26C changes we track are delivered switched on, so users may see them without anyone acting. See the ones rated medium or high impact.

Which former opt-ins are now standard in 26C?

Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list names 36 features whose opt-in period ended with 26C: 14 are switched on for everyone and 22 need setup. See them.

What's new in Oracle Fusion 26D?

Oracle's 26D What's New documents list 768 features across the modules we cover: 173 on by default, 124 on by default with potential setup, 361 setup required, 89 opt-in, 21 needing another action, per Oracle's "Action to Enable" column. 23 opt-ins also end with 26D. 26D by module.

What should I test after an Oracle Fusion quarterly update?

Start with a baseline regression: validate your current configuration, key end-to-end business flows, integrations, critical reports, custom workflows and extensions, security for new or changed pages, and the features switched on automatically. Our 26C what-to-test checklist adds the changes and former opt-ins for 26C.

Is Fusion Updates affiliated with Oracle?

No. It's an independent site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle. Summaries are condensed from Oracle's public readiness documentation, and every entry links to its Oracle source page.
